title: Finite-root realization of a relative Cartier Kummer class
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum of [def-pur-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_F$ and uniformizer $\varpi_F$, $n\geq1$, and $A=\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^n$. Use the prescribed pro-etale twist of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] and ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Put $N=\ell^n$ and $R=\mathbf Z/N\mathbf Z$. Then $NA=0$. For every $k$-scheme $S$, the etale roots sheaf $\mu^{\mathrm{et}}_{N,S}$ is a flat $R_S$-module and
$$L_S:=\mu^{\mathrm{et}}_{N,S}\otimes^L_{R_S}A_S\cong\mu^{\mathrm{et}}_{N,S}\otimes_{R_S}A_S$$
is concentrated in degree zero. No flatness of $A$ over $R$ is required. For $C_S=\nu_S^*$ [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback], the roots-projection convention of [def-pur-frame-class] gives the specified isomorphism $\theta_S:C_SL_S\xrightarrow{\sim}A_S(1)$.

Let $T,B$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, $T\to B$ smooth of relative dimension $d$, and $i:D\hookrightarrow T$ an effective Cartier divisor smooth over $B$ of pure codimension one [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-pc-divisor-line-bundle, def-pur-frame-class]. Put $W=T\setminus D$. Let $c^e_{D,A}:i_*A_D\to L_T[2]$ be the relative supported Kummer morphism of [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer], for $(\mathcal O_T(D),s_D|_W)$ in the Yoneda convention [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary], and let $c^p_{D,A}:i_*A_D\to A_T(1)[2]$ be [lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map]. Under the canonical supported-constant source comparison $\epsilon_i:C_T(i_*A_D)\xrightarrow{\sim}i_*A_D$, one has the equality of actual derived morphisms
$$\theta_T[2]\circ C_T(c^e_{D,A})=c^p_{D,A}\circ\epsilon_i.$$
Both morphisms are the relative roots Kummer boundary followed by derived scalar extension from $R$ to $A$, with the displayed comparison on the pro-etale target. Under the supported-Hom identification [lem-pur-supported-hom], the relative divisor class $\operatorname{cl}(D)$ of [lem-pur-divisor-class] is $c^p_{D,A}$, with the normalization of [def-pur-cartier-agreement-maps]. For every etale neighbourhood $U\to T$ on which $D_U=V(f)$, its restriction is $-\partial\kappa(f)$, with $\partial$ and $\kappa$ as in [def-pur-frame-class].

source.place: Step 1, relative Kummer class: finite-root twist, relative supported morphism, Yoneda sign and supported-class agreement; expanded realization proof steps 3--5

proof.text: Write $\ell=\varpi_F b$ in $\mathcal O_F$. Then $\ell^n=\varpi_F^n b^n$ is zero in $A$, so the quotient map from $\mathbf Z$ factors through $R=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$. This is exactly the annihilating exponent used in [def-pur-frame-class]. Since $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, $N=\ell^n$ is invertible on every $k$-scheme $S$. No divisibility condition on $n$ has been introduced.

source.place: Final paragraph: choose an exponent killing the finite coefficients

proof.text: Apply finite_etale_torsion_twist_line over ULift(ZMod N) in degree one to obtain flatness. The already proved residueLineData helper in P1KummerScalarEndpointExistence, applied to the empty Cartier divisor, supplies the normalized root-line map and its universal derived scalar-unit property. For any other universal unit, its Hom bijection supplies the compatible map to the degree-zero representative; IsDerivedBaseChange.isIso proves that map invertible. This includes the empty scheme and uses no flatness of A over the residue ring.

source.place: Tags 06YQ (lemma-bounded-flat-K-flat) and 06YU (definition-derived-tor); finite root line as in etale-cohomology.tex, section-kummer

proof.text: Write the positive coefficient level as n+1. The coefficient ring is definitionally finiteTateCoefficient at index n; relativeCartierProExt directly selects the published class on that branch. finite_tate_site_descent supplies a root-normalized comparison. finiteTate_local_root_tensors_hom_ext proves uniqueness by evaluating both normalized comparisons on every locally lifted pure tensor. This is exactly RelativeCartierRootNormalized.

source.place: Final paragraph: identify the extended finite-root target with the prescribed Tate twist

proof.text: The chosen pair in cartier_kummer_map satisfies CartierEtaleKummerNormalization. At the positive level and the annihilating exponent this proves that agreementCartierEtale is the normalized supported boundary. Take the unique R-coefficient boundary from ordinary_supported_kummer_uniqueBoundary and apply supported_kummer_boundary_scalar directly to this boundary and agreementCartierEtale. This gives the required R-boundary witness and full normalized derived scalar square.

source.place: Paragraphs 1--3 and final paragraph: relative torsor, supported realization and derived scalar extension

proof.text: The same chosen pair satisfies CartierKummerRealization, supplying normalized source and target isomorphisms and its Ext composition equation. Under the comparison adjunction the source constant comparison agrees with the monoidal unit comparison: prove this using the sheafification adjunction and the monoidal adjunction unit formula. The uniqueness clause of supported-constant-exchange-normalization therefore identifies the supplied source map with gamma. Apply Ext.hom to the realization equation; Ext.comp_hom, Ext.mk₀_hom and Ext.mapExactFunctor_hom turn it into the stated equality of actual derived morphisms with functorialCupExactHom. The target is already root normalized, as required.

source.place: Relative-boundary normalization and final scalar-extension paragraph: actual normalized realization

proof.text: Apply cartier_class_agreement to identify the global generalDivisorClass with agreementCartierMap. Apply divisor_class to the smooth codimension-one Cartier family. The uniqueness of generalDivisorEtaleClasses identifies its supplied class family with the existing chosen family. Its local restriction clause is then exactly the negative frameBoundary formula on every etale principal presentation.

tool_uses.why: Finite etale root lines, specialized to coefficient R, supply flatness on arbitrary schemes; this is coefficient algebra, not a replacement purity route.

Published normalized pro-etale Cartier morphism, the object this item realizes.
Uniqueness of the relative Yoneda normalization identifies the ordinary components, not just their absolute Chern classes.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-O2-5490a16e1 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: No new nodes and the statement is unchanged apart from the def-kun-derived-tensor stmt_dep for the displayed derived tensor. The item is a Q123 2026-10-22 statement-only child with no re-split note of its own; it is not on the drop list, still unsplit in live and side-live, and has no cycle. Steps 1-4, 6 and 7 are checked against the cited statements and their hypotheses. Step 2: finite-etale-twist-line with ring R makes mu flat, 06YQ (checked in tags; the 06YS citation in lem-pc-bounded-above-flat-kflat-site is a mis-tag, maintainer note) gives K-flatness, and derived-change-of-rings uses the identity resolution, so flatness of A is never needed. Step 3: sigma from finite-root-site-comparison composed with the inverse of theta_{n} from tate-root-projection-reduction equals the inverse roots projection of def-pur-frame-class. Step 4: the scalar-extension clause of asd-ordinary-supported-kummer plus supported-root-scalar-site-comparison. Steps 6-7: class-agreement and divisor-class, with the Yoneda local sign -dkappa(f). Edge cases checked: n=1, ramified e>n where A is not flat over R, empty S or D, and D=V(t). Two faults, both fixed: (1) step 5 asserted that the realization's target comparison is theta_T, but CartierKummerRealization only gives some root-normalized q; the fix proves theta_T is root-normalized (using p_{n-1}) and that root-normalized comparisons are unique, since roots lift pro-etale locally by twist-sheaf-locally-free(2) and the unit images of z(x)a generate locally; epsilon_i is unique by the d.Lrho=rho'.q characterization. (2) step 2 did not tie the displayed tensor to def-kun-derived-tensor; one sentence and the use were added. The fix was left by an earlier interrupted pass; I re-checked it and kept it. Batch-5: lem-pod-etale-stalk-tensor-scalar (generic stalk/scalar-extension algebra) and lem-poincare-compatible-primitive-roots (local triviality of mu) are neither assumption nor a step of their proofs, and both are already in the stmt_dep closure; the fix adds nothing to the batch-5 closure. Accepted.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
